'정본역'이라는 이름은 구약은 <b>맛소라 본문</b>을, 신약은 <b>.en: The name ‘Jeongbon’ (“standard text”) means that the Old Testament is based on the Masoretic Text and the New Testament on the Received Text (Textus Receptus). It is not a denial of the value of other translations. Over ten years, the translator reviewed the existing Korean versions of the King James Bible verse by verse, compared them again with the original languages, and corrected them.

1611년 흠정, 1769년 표준 본문의 <b>킹제임스 성경 영어 본문<.en: A parallel Bible that sets the English text of the King James Bible — authorized in 1611, in its 1769 standard text — side by side, verse by verse, with a Korean text newly translated by comparing it with the Hebrew and Greek originals. It contains all 39 books of the Old Testament and 27 of the New: 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,102 verses.

<b>· 싸우지 않습니다.</b> 다른 견해를 조롱하는 대신 본문의 저울.en: · We do not fight. Instead of mocking other views, we weigh them on the scales of the text.

<b>· 어느 진영의 편도 들지 않습니다.</b> 좌우 어느 쪽의 오류를.en: · We take no side in any camp. Whenever we point out an error on the left or the right, we always put the matching error on the other side on the same scales.

<b>· 어떤 날짜도 계산하지 않습니다.</b> 재림의 시기를 산출하는.en: · We calculate no dates. Setting the time of the Second Coming is something the Bible forbids.

<b>· 어떤 실명도 부르지 않습니다.</b> 이름을 부르는 순간 원리는.en: · We name no names. The moment a name is called, the principle becomes an arrow aimed at someone else, and the reader hides behind the target.

<b>· 일상으로 착륙시킵니다.</b> 결말을 아는 사람의 월요일 아침은.en: · We bring it down to daily life. The Monday morning of someone who knows the ending ought to look different.

<b>· 추측과 본문을 구분합니다.</b> 어디까지가 기록이고 어디부터가.en: · We separate speculation from the text. Each time, we make clear where the record ends and where interpretation begins.
